name: CSG Compact Premium Natal Report (private Groq child)

parameters.text: ={{ 'Return ONLY valid JSON for this one narrative slot. Use only the supplied facts; do not add factual claims. Required shape: {\"sectionId\":\"' + $json.sectionId + '\",\"blocks\":[{\"role\":\"narrative|reflection|practical\",\"prose\":\"...\",\"factIds\":[\"fact-id\"]}]}\nINPUT: ' + JSON.stringify({sectionId: $json.sectionId, role: $json.narrativeFactPack.role, wordLimit: $json.narrativeFactPack.wordLimit, facts: $json.narrativeFactPack.facts}) }}

={{ 'Repair ONLY this narrative slot and return ONLY valid JSON. Keep the same sectionId. Use only supplied facts; remove unsupported claims. This is the single allowed targeted repair (attempt 1). Required shape: {\"sectionId\":\"' + $json.sectionId + '\",\"blocks\":[{\"role\":\"narrative|reflection|practical\",\"prose\":\"...\",\"factIds\":[\"fact-id\"]}]}\nINPUT: ' + JSON.stringify({sectionId: $json.sectionId, repairAttempt: 1, role: $json.narrativeFactPack.role, wordLimit: $json.narrativeFactPack.wordLimit, facts: $json.narrativeFactPack.facts}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all(); if (items.length !== 1 || !items[0].json.narrativeBlock) throw new Error('accumulator received no validated slot'); return items;

const candidates = [...$('Accumulate Validated Slot').all(), ...$input.all()].map(i => i.json); const bySection = new Map(); for (const item of candidates) { const id = item.narrativeBlock?.sectionId; if (id && item.narrativeBlock) bySection.set(id, item); } const expected = ['identity','inner-world','integration','dynamics']; if (bySection.size !== 4 || expected.some(id => !bySection.has(id))) throw new Error('final quality gate rejected incomplete narrative slots'); const first = bySection.get(expected[0]); const blocks = expected.map(id => bySection.get(id).narrativeBlock); return [{ json: { schemaVersion: 'csg-compact-report-callback-v1', reportId: first.reportId, status: 'approved', reportType: 'natal', skeleton: first._deterministicSnapshot.skeleton, tables: first._deterministicSnapshot.tables, blocks } }];
